# RUM Version Policy Compliance

Shows policy-target compliance for manually injected (agentless) RUM applications.

Policy model:
- effective_target_version: selected from tenant configured policy (custom if set, else latest_stable)
- on_target: app version equals effective target
- below_target: app is supported but below target
- unsupported: app is below support floor only when an explicit floor is exposed by API
- above_target: app is newer than current effective target

Human-readable labels:
- when Dynatrace exposes a readable tag label in the manual insertion tag response, it is shown as Effective Target Label
- otherwise the dashboard falls back to numeric version IDs only

Expected events:
- RUMJSVersion (per app)
- RUMJSVersionSyncSummary (per run)
- RUMJSBaseline (latest, oldest_supported, effective_target)
- RUMJSPolicySummary (on/below/unsupported counts)
- RUMJSPolicyApp (per-app policy status)

Support floor behavior:
- if support floor is not exposed by API, unsupported remains 0 and versions below target are classified as below_target

1.query: fetch events | filter source == "rum_classic_api" and isNotNull(app_count) | sort timestamp desc | limit 1 | fields app_count = toLong(app_count)
1.title: Apps Synced (Latest Run)

10.query: fetch events | filter source == "rum_classic_policy_summary" and isNotNull(apps_on_target) | sort timestamp desc | limit 1 | fields apps_on_target = toLong(apps_on_target)
10.title: Apps On Target

11.query: fetch events | filter source == "rum_classic_policy_summary" and isNotNull(apps_below_target) | sort timestamp desc | limit 1 | fields apps_below_target = toLong(apps_below_target)
11.title: Apps Below Target

12.query: fetch events | filter source == "rum_classic_policy_summary" and isNotNull(apps_unsupported) | sort timestamp desc | limit 1 | fields apps_unsupported = toLong(apps_unsupported)
12.title: Apps Unsupported (Known Floor Only)

13.query: fetch events | filter source == "rum_classic_policy_summary" and isNotNull(effective_target_label) and effective_target_label != "" | sort timestamp desc | limit 1 | fields effective_target_label
13.title: Effective Target Label

2.query: fetch events | filter source == "rum_classic_api" and isNotNull(versions_found) | sort timestamp desc | limit 1 | fields versions_found = toLong(versions_found)
2.title: Distinct JS Versions (Latest Run)

3.query: fetch events | filter source == "rum_classic_api" and isNotNull(app_count) and isNotNull(fetched_at) | sort timestamp desc | limit 1 | fields fetched_at
3.title: Last Sync Time (Latest Run)

4.query: fetch events | filter source == "rum_classic_api" and isNotNull(application_id) and isNotNull(js_library_version) | fields ts = timestamp, app_id = application_id, js_version = js_library_version | sort ts desc | dedup app_id | summarize apps = count(), by: {js_version} | sort apps desc, js_version desc
4.title: Apps by JS Library Version

5.query: fetch events | filter source == "rum_classic_policy_app" and isNotNull(application_id) and isNotNull(policy_status) | fields ts = timestamp, app_id = application_id, app_name = application_name, js_version = js_library_version, human_readable_target_label = human_readable_target_label, policy_status = policy_status, effective_target_version = effective_target_version, effective_target_policy = effective_target_policy, latest_version = latest_version, oldest_supported_version = oldest_supported_version, support_floor_known = support_floor_known, fetched_at = fetched_at | fieldsAdd app_name = coalesce(app_name, app_id) | sort ts desc | dedup app_id | fields app_name, app_id, policy_status, js_version, human_readable_target_label, effective_target_version, effective_target_policy, oldest_supported_version, support_floor_known, latest_version, fetched_at, last_seen = ts | sort policy_status asc, app_name asc
5.title: RUM Policy Status by Application

6.query: fetch events | filter source == "rum_classic_baseline" and isNotNull(latest_version) | sort timestamp desc | limit 1 | fields latest_version
6.title: Latest Available RUM Version

7.query: fetch events | filter source == "rum_classic_baseline" and isNotNull(oldest_supported_version) | sort timestamp desc | limit 1 | fields oldest_supported_version
7.title: Support Floor Version (If Exposed)

8.query: fetch events | filter source == "rum_classic_policy_summary" and isNotNull(effective_target_version) | sort timestamp desc | limit 1 | fields effective_target_version
8.title: Effective Target Version

9.query: fetch events | filter source == "rum_classic_policy_summary" and isNotNull(effective_target_policy) | sort timestamp desc | limit 1 | fields effective_target_policy
9.title: Effective Target Policy
